rationale: The plan explicitly runs edgeR's exactTest with an arbitrary fixed dispersion (BCV=0.4) to produce PValue/FDR outputs, which is exactly the invalid inferential approach the reference forbids — no amount of caveat text changes that p-values and BH-FDR are reported as if statistically meaningful. Normalization is done pre-model via TMM/CPM outside a count-based GLM framework rather than as size factors inside a model, and there is no true QC step (no PCA, sample distance, or outlier policy, since only two samples exist) beyond library size checks. Low-count filtering is reasonable and minimal. The design formula/contrast is not properly specified as a model (no reference level or GLM design matrix, just exactTest group labels), and enrichment is run on the invalid fixed-dispersion ranking rather than clearly stated descriptive log2FC, though the collections/versions and universe matching are reasonably described. Report completeness is good on versions/thresholds/caveats but undermined by including significance testing that should not exist.
